visual_synopsis: In a plain office with grey vertical blinds, a mustachioed boss in a grey suit works his desk phone in call after call while a skinny young man with a shaggy shoulder-length wig, striped blue top, bright scarf and red lipstick sits at the computer and keeps bursting into passionate eyes-closed singing in close-up. The two alternate for the whole clip, the boss also stepping through a doorway into a beige adjoining room between calls; the long-haired character reads as an effeminate young man rather than a woman, so this is caricature rather than drag.
